title: Don't Trust Sneaky Notes
goal: Some pages whisper instructions. Always ask a grown-up first.
mascot_lines: Sometimes a page says: 'Click here NOW!'
That might be a sneaky note. We don't have to listen.
If something feels weird, ask a grown-up.

choices.label: 🙅 Close it and tell a grown-up

tier2.rephrase: A pop-up wants something secret. Should you give it away?

tier3.nudge: A safe kid never types passwords for prizes. Tell a grown-up.
